text:
nora: Heads-up — ACME asked for a private marketplace offer that bundles reserved commit + HW credit, and they want a co-announcement ~6 weeks out. Can we scope discounts, renewal term, and whether HW kickers are allowed in the PO?

diego: timeline seems doable. biggest dependency is SI enablement (Aster) — they need a validated deployment guide and an enablement pack. can we parallelize? :eyes:

aisha: legal: we can do private offers but need to ensure the marketplace PO reflects the renewal opt-out window and usage reporting obligations. also confirm data residency clause for ACME. i'll draft required language.

tom: finance: flagging billing recognition for HW credit. we'd prefer to amortize HW credit over the term instead of one-off revenue reduction. if sales wants upfront invoice credit, we need an accounting path.

kevin: sales POV — ACME expects a visible discount ladder so field can sell the value to procurement. proposed starter structure below, subject to legal/finance: 

```
Commit: $180,000 / 12 months
Discount tiers (applies to hosted inference API list price):
  - >= $180k/year -> 20% off list
  - >= $350k/year -> 27% off list + $25k HW credit
  - >= $600k/year -> 33% off list + $50k HW credit
Term: 12 months (auto-renew unless 60-day opt-out)
Marketplace SKU: RWD-DEDICATED-BASE-1
```

kevin: also want to include a 90-day ramp credit for proof-of-concept usage (metered until commit kicks in).

aisha: legal: okay to include ramp credits but must cap them and include clawback if commit not reached. i'll add a clause: "ramp credits applied only upon execution of the final PO and recoupable over the first 3 invoice cycles if commit not met."

tom: finance: that clawback approach works. also need to confirm how marketplace handles private-offer amendments mid-term (e.g., adding seats or increasing commit). we should document amendment flow.

diego: ops question — Private offer + HW credit + SI bundle: who publishes the marketplace private offer? partner enablement or partnerships? marketplace-bot: Draft private-offer created in staging by partnerships (ID: po-2024-ACME-01). Please review the draft entry and approve for publish window.

nora: @diego partnerships will own the publish, but we need SI docs from @kevin/Aster before publishing. kevin can you chase Aster onboarding timeline?

kevin: pinged Aster lead earlier; they estimated 3 weeks for basic deployment guide and 5 weeks for runbook + run-through. if we compress, we risk leaving out edge-case infra notes.

aisha: timeline risk noted — if announcement date is firm, we can publish a "private offer (preview)" and include a clear "SI enablement coming" statement, but legal prefers not to overpromise.

nora: tradeoff acknowledged. proposal: target announcement at week 6, publish private offer in marketplace 1 week before announce in preview mode, run co-announcement once SI runbook is verified. will draft calendar.

kevin: sales OK with preview if we get commit terms inline. field hates uncertainty though. :grimacing:

tom: finance asks that the preview state must include final billing terms (amortization and clawback) to avoid revenue surprises.

aisha: i'll prepare the PO addendum language and the clawback matrix (percent recoup schedule).

diego: ops will prepare a short checklist for publishing: marketplace SKU mapping, pricing metadata, legal PO text, SI runbook link, partner contact table. i'll add it to the draft.

nora: great. i'll consolidate and share a single PDF+notion page by EOD with the timeline and the exact numbers. tagging: @kevin @diego @aisha @tom. thanks all :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled — review window opens in 48h for po-2024-ACME-01.
